title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Numbers 8: the lamps of the lamp stand, the cleansing and wave offering of the Levites, and their years of service.

questions.text: How many lamps were to give light in front of the lamp stand?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Aaron that when he lit the lamps, the seven lamps should give light in front of the lamp stand.

questions.text: What was the lamp stand made of?
questions.explanation: The lamp stand was beaten work of gold, from its base to its flowers, made according to the pattern Yahweh had shown Moses.

questions.text: As part of their cleansing, what were the Levites to do with a razor?
questions.explanation: To cleanse them, the Levites were sprinkled with the water of cleansing, shaved their whole bodies with a razor, and washed their clothes.

questions.text: Who laid their hands on the Levites when they were presented before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: When the Levites were presented before Yahweh, the children of Israel laid their hands on them.

questions.text: As what kind of offering did Aaron offer the Levites before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Aaron offered the Levites before Yahweh as a wave offering on behalf of the children of Israel.

questions.text: Instead of whom did Yahweh take the Levites for himself?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he had taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

questions.text: When did Yahweh sanctify the firstborn of Israel for himself?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that on the day he struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, he sanctified the firstborn of Israel for himself.

answers.text: On the day the tabernacle was set up
On the day they crossed the sea
On the day of the first census
On the day he struck the firstborn in Egypt

questions.text: To whom did Yahweh give the Levites as a gift?
questions.explanation: Yahweh gave the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting.

questions.text: From what age were the Levites to go in to serve in the work of the Tent of Meeting, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Yahweh assigned the Levites to go in to serve in the work of the Tent of Meeting from twenty-five years old and upward.

questions.text: What were the Levites to do from the age of fifty?
questions.explanation: From fifty they were to retire from doing the work and serve no more, but they could assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: Teach the young priests the law
Guard the gate of the court
Retire from the work and assist their brothers
Leave the camp and return to their tribe
